categories.name: Board Integration, LEDs & User Input
categories.description: Covers the integrated board demo, use of onboard resources, LED initialization and status indications, and debounced USER-button input and state toggling.
requirements: The firmware shall be a single integrated application that validates major NUCLEO-C5A3ZG board functions.
The demo shall use onboard resources wherever possible to validate the major NUCLEO-C5A3ZG board functions.
The firmware shall initialize the onboard LEDs.
The firmware shall blink a status LED after boot.
The firmware shall use LEDs to indicate network state.
The firmware shall use LEDs to indicate MQTT state.
The firmware shall detect the onboard USER button.
Each press of the onboard USER button shall toggle an application state.
The firmware shall register each physical USER button actuation as exactly one press event despite switch contact transitions.

categories.name: UART Console & Diagnostics
categories.description: Covers the ST-LINK virtual serial configuration and the firmware’s general and periodic board-health reporting over UART.
requirements: The firmware shall use the ST-LINK Virtual COM Port at 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, and 1 stop bit.
The firmware shall print boot, network, HTTP, MQTT, ADC, PWM, and button status over UART.
The firmware shall print a consolidated board-health status periodically over UART.

categories.name: Ethernet Configuration & Network Validation
categories.description: Covers DHCP-based network setup, reporting acquired network addresses, and optional NTP validation over UDP.
requirements: The firmware shall acquire network configuration through DHCP.
The firmware shall print the acquired IP address over UART.
The firmware shall print the acquired gateway address over UART.
The firmware shall print the acquired DNS server address over UART.
The demo may validate NTP separately over UDP port 123 as additional networking validation; NTP validation shall not be treated as HTTP validation.

categories.name: MQTT Communication
categories.description: Covers broker connectivity and recovery, telemetry and button-state publishing, and control-topic subscription.
requirements: After each USER button press, the firmware shall publish the updated application state over MQTT.
The firmware shall connect to broker.hivemq.com:1883 using non-TLS MQTT.
The firmware shall publish telemetry every 5 seconds.
The firmware shall publish MQTT messages to the topic /firmgen/c5/telemetry.
The firmware shall subscribe to the MQTT topic /firmgen/c5/control.
When an MQTT connection is lost and network connectivity is available again, the firmware shall re-establish the MQTT connection.

categories.name: HTTP Weather & Time Services
categories.description: Covers HTTP retrieval of Bengaluru weather data and current date and time from public services.
requirements: The firmware shall use HTTP GET to fetch current Bengaluru weather information from a public endpoint such as Open-Meteo.
The firmware shall fetch the current date and time using an HTTP-accessible time service.
For the assumed sample data, the weather location shall be Bengaluru, Karnataka.

categories.name: ADC & Analog Measurement
categories.description: Covers internal-reference and temperature-sensor ADC sampling and reporting of raw and converted measurements.
requirements: The firmware shall validate the ADC without external hardware by sampling internal VREFINT and the MCU internal temperature sensor.
The firmware shall print raw ADC values.
The firmware shall print converted ADC values.

categories.name: PWM Timer & Output
categories.description: Covers timer-driven PWM generation on a header pin, its default frequency and duty cycle, and waveform verification.
requirements: The firmware shall generate PWM using a hardware timer on an available PWM-capable header pin.
The default PWM test shall use a frequency of 1 kHz.
The default PWM test shall use a 50% duty cycle.
The PWM waveform shall be stable at 1 kHz and 50% duty cycle when verified with an oscilloscope or logic analyzer.
